scope: parallel targeted evidence sweep across all ten publication-blocking candidates; not a new discovery batch
method: Direct competitor same buyer + job + workflow; referenced product/primary sources. No absence-of-rivals assertion from sparse search. Rejected ideas do not require zero-cash feasibility demonstration.

entries.name: Outbound AI Investment Notification Desk
entries.finding: Treasury ONS is the filing system; Kharon OISP screening overlaps but is not verified as the same pre-filing evidence approval workflow.
entries.remaining: specialized compliance workflow competitor + zero-extra-cash proof

entries.name: Text Watermark Rollout QA Matrix
entries.finding: Approved-only detector access means MVP limited to manual release controls; no free detector API assumed.
entries.remaining: exact direct competitor + no-cash rollout assurance app proof

entries.name: AI Compute Credit Evidence Pack
entries.finding: Official municipal report describes RMB 5m Bank of China Token Loan backed partly by usage and contract data; financing model predates Oct 2026 feed, and no third-party lender-approved evidence format is shown.
entries.remaining: bank-standard buyer need and acceptance specs + direct product + no-cash proof

entries.name: Dataset Bias Acceptance Desk
entries.finding: Cleanlab addresses dataset issue triage; purchaser-signoff workflow differentiator unproven.
entries.remaining: acceptance signoff competitors and scope proof

entries.name: Clinical Trial Simulation Decision Dossier
entries.finding: Clinical prediction and trial simulation providers exist; postforecast approval/reconciliation niche not confirmed. Clinical data privacy and validity add cost and assurance risk.
entries.remaining: direct decision-governance rivals and production security/cost proof

entries.name: Elektrikli Traktör Görev Simülatörü
entries.finding: India pilot evidence may not transfer to Turkish tractor duty cycles and implements; generic off-highway TCO tooling is adjacent.
entries.remaining: tractor-specific competitors and Turkey-validated workload inputs

entries.name: Robot Data Rights Desk
entries.finding: Robot vendor agreement explicitly licenses customer runtime data for vendor improvements and research; confirms buyer pain, not existence or absence of dedicated software competitors.
entries.remaining: buyer-side contract data-rights software rivals and legal/data security feasibility

entries.name: Vendor-Built Agent Exit & Handover Gate
entries.finding: Specific vendor exit acceptance tests, handover documents and operational checklist templates are already freely supplied; need prove incremental buyer workflow over free checklists.
entries.remaining: commercial acceptance platform rivals and willingness to pay

entries.name: EU AI Text Disclosure Register
entries.finding: AI Disclosure Register sells Article 50 agency content decision/questionnaire, editorial-oversight input, dated rule-versioned evidence history and PDF exports. Same buyer/job/workflow overlap; no unique publisher niche.
entries.remaining: none for rejection; no catalog publication

entries.name: Robot Pilot Acceptance Desk
entries.finding: NIOSH Oct 7 bulletin supports dynamic construction-robot safety needs, but does not verify a commercial pilot acceptance product. Separate robot commissioning tools still require direct comparison.
entries.remaining: same-job pilot software and dynamic safety cost/security proof
